snippet.title: The Killing Stone - World Premiere Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
The world premiere reveal of The Killing Stone, a unique narrative driven card battler where player must save a cursed family by beating the Devil at his own game, and a folk horror set in the 17th century in a remote region of the Arctic circle. 

The Killing Stone is from Question (the team that brought you The Blackout Club and The Magic Circle). Wishlist it now on Steam! 
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
